title: Builder Signals · 2026-07-28
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 21 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 12 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 团队
featured.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux says OpenAI has never felt more focused or productive. More concretely, he argues that ChatGPT has moved beyond answering questions into actually doing work: negotiating an internet bill, unsubscribing from spam, or finding the right deal can all start with one prompt from a phone. He says it handles at least 20 tasks for him every day and still surprises him.
featured.insightZh: Thibault Sottiaux 说，OpenAI 当前的专注度和运转状态是他从未见过的强。更具体地说，他认为 ChatGPT 已经从“回答问题”进入“替人完成事务”的阶段：谈判宽带账单、清理订阅邮件、寻找购买或出行方案，都可以从手机上用一个 prompt 发起；他自己每天让它处理至少 20 件事，仍会被结果惊到。

featured.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
featured.summaryEn: Peter Yang highlights a mainstream adoption barrier that has little to do with token limits: trust. After speaking with people outside the AI bubble in Canada, he found that their primary concern was whether ChatGPT could be trusted enough to access sensitive services such as Gmail, Calendar, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office.
featured.insightZh: Peter Yang 从普通用户的视角提醒，AI 产品接下来真正的采用门槛可能不是 token 是否够用，而是信任。离开 AI 圈、与加拿大的普通用户交流后，他听到的首要顾虑是：是否足够信任 ChatGPT，以至于愿意开放 Gmail、Calendar、Google Workspace 或 Microsoft Office 等高敏感度账户和数据。

featured.title: OpenAI’s Compute Chief: We Can’t Build Fast Enough | Sachin Katti
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI's binding constraint is not demand for AI but the speed of the physical world, so it is moving from buying compute toward co-designing data centers, power, networks, and custom silicon. Sachin Katti, OpenAI's head of industrial compute, describes AI data centers as giant factories that turn electrons into tokens. Chips, interconnects, and transformers all generate enough heat to require system-wide liquid cooling. He says every unit of new compute is consumed immediately, while bottlenecks span permitting, gas turbines, transformers, transmission, and skilled construction. OpenAI says it funds new generation and grid infrastructure wherever it builds, is exploring behind-the-meter gas generation, and sees nuclear power as a dense, clean source that “can't come soon enough.” On silicon, Jalapeno is designed around known models and workloads to maximize tokens per watt. Katti says…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI 面临的核心约束不是缺少 AI 需求，而是物理世界的建设速度跟不上算力需求，因此它正在从采购 compute 走向共同设计数据中心、电力、网络与自研芯片。 OpenAI 工业计算负责人 Sachin Katti 把 AI 数据中心描述为“把电子变成 token 的巨型工厂”：芯片、互连、变压器都产生大量热量，液冷必须覆盖整个系统。OpenAI 称新上线的算力会被立刻消耗，过去每次认为可以放慢建设，最终都会发现供给不足；真正的瓶颈遍布许可、燃气轮机、变压器、输电和专业施工等供应链。公司承诺建设数据中心时同步投资新增发电与电网基础设施，也在探索场内燃气发电，并认为核能作为高密度清洁能源“越快越好”。 在芯片侧，Jalapeno 的目标是针对已知模型和 workload 做软硬件协同设计，最大化每瓦可生成的 token。Katti 称其从设计到 tape-out 仅九个月，得益于有 TPU 经验的团队、Broadcom 合作、OpenAI 对未来模型的了解，以及 AI 辅助芯片设计。OpenAI 还通过 MRC 网络协议让十万 GPU 规模的集群在链路或设备故障时自动绕路。Stargate 则不是单一数据中心，而是整合 Microsoft、AWS、Google、Oracle、neocloud、芯片伙伴和自建运营能力的持续扩展策略。 ⚠️ 本次运行降级到 azure-openai-responses/gpt-5.6-sol-2026-07-09（主模型 Claude Opus 4.8 当时不可用，已自动 fallback）

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监，前 Google Gemini、Veo、Nano Banana 负责人
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru argues that claims of limited shipped AI impact miss the current phase of the cycle. In Phase 1, companies with distribution are rapidly expanding into adjacent problems and using AI to build capabilities that once required substantial custom software, such as virtual try-on. The playbook is still forming, so ecosystem-level impact remains hard to see. Phase 2 will bring more net-new features and innovation, making AI's effect on software undeniable.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 认为，“AI 还没有在产品中形成可见影响”的判断忽略了产业所处阶段。Phase 1 中，拥有分发能力的公司正借助 AI 快速进入相邻问题域，并以更低成本实现过去需要大量定制软件的功能，例如虚拟试衣；这些公司仍在摸索 playbook，因此生态级影响尚未完全显现。Phase 2 才会出现更多全新功能和创新，届时 AI 对软件生态形态的改变会变得无可争议。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Amjad Masad points to an observation from a former Anthropic employee: attackers prefer heavily subsidized AI-lab subscriptions over open models for conducting attacks. The claim reframes the security debate around practical attack economics, where inexpensive access to powerful hosted systems may be more attractive than running open models.
items.insightZh: Amjad Masad 转发一位前 Anthropic 员工的观察：攻击者相比开放模型，更偏好使用 AI 实验室大幅补贴的订阅产品来实施攻击。这个判断把安全讨论从“开放模型是否更危险”拉回到实际攻击经济学：对攻击者而言，可低价获得的高能力托管服务可能更有吸引力。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Guillermo Rauch shared two developer-infrastructure signals. First, Vercel co-signed the Open Weights and American AI Leadership letter, positioning open weights as the logical next frontier after open source, data, protocols, and research. Second, he compiled the TypeScript Vercel CLI into a fully static native binary with scriptc: 1.28 MB, 1.5 ms mean startup overhead, and 2.94 seconds mean compilation, with no embedded V8 or QuickJS and code translated by GLM 5.2 Fast.
items.insightZh: Guillermo Rauch 分享了两条开发者基础设施信号。其一，Vercel 联署支持 Open Weights 与 American AI Leadership，认为开放源码、数据、协议和研究之后，开放权重是合乎逻辑的下一前沿。其二，他用 scriptc 将 Vercel CLI 的 TypeScript 编译为原生静态二进制：1.28 MB、平均启动开销 1.5 ms、平均编译 2.94 秒，不嵌入 V8 或 QuickJS，代码由 GLM 5.2 Fast 转译。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie argues that an applied AI layer is still required between model breakthroughs and real-world process transformation. Enterprises must connect systems, supply the right data, design human decision points, build feedback loops, and meet regulatory requirements; an agent for bank onboarding therefore looks fundamentally different from one for legal contract review or life sciences. Better models expand the ambition of automatable workflows, increasing rather than eliminating the need for deep vertical app…
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 认为，模型能力突破与真实世界流程改造之间仍缺少一层“Applied AI”。企业要把智能接进实际工作，必须完成系统连接、数据供给、人机决策 UX、反馈闭环以及监管合规；银行客户 onboarding、法律合同审查和生命科学流程因此不会共享同一套 agent 实现。模型越强，企业能自动化的流程越雄心勃勃，对垂直行业深度和应用层能力的需求反而越大，这为独立公司留下了大量机会。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan offers a deliberately minimal piece of startup advice: do not treat building or professional identity as role-play; be earnest. His wording, “Don’t LARP. Be earnest,” puts genuine commitment ahead of performance or signaling.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 用一句极简的创业建议强调行为与姿态的区别：不要把创业或专业身份当作角色扮演，而要真诚、认真地做事。原话只有“Don’t LARP. Be earnest”，重点不在包装，而在真实投入。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang offers three practical observations about AI products and content. AI adoption should be measured by the time from a user need arriving to the solution shipping, not by tokens burned. The more general a chat product becomes, the harder a blank prompt box can be for users, which helps explain the abundance of AI tutorials. Her own publishing system is similarly direct: post ideas as they occur, often after saying them aloud, averaging three posts in 15 to 20 minutes a day.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 提出三条关于 AI 产品与内容的实用判断：企业不应以消耗了多少 token 衡量 AI adoption，而应衡量从用户需求出现到功能上线的时间；通用聊天产品越通用，空白输入框带来的使用障碍越大，这也解释了为何 AI 教程大量涌现；她自己的内容生产方式则是不过度打磨，把线下已经表达过的想法即时发布，每天约三条、总计只需 15 到 20 分钟。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari predicts that “proof of prompt” will soon replace “proof of work.” The concise claim points to a changing way of demonstrating output in AI-assisted work, where value may increasingly lie in defining the task and directing the system rather than merely showing the amount of manual labor invested.
items.insightZh: Nikunj Kothari 预测，“proof of prompt” 很快会取代 “proof of work”。这句简短判断指向一种新的产出证明方式：在 AI 辅助工作中，过程价值可能更多体现在如何定义任务和驱动系统，而不再只是展示投入了多少人工劳动。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Dan Shipper says he is taking a week off to write what he calls the definitive history of how Codex happened, based on deep interviews with OpenAI insiders. The piece is scheduled for publication in Every in a few weeks, with breadcrumbs and learnings to be shared along the way.
items.insightZh: Dan Shipper 宣布将用一周时间撰写 Codex 诞生的“权威历史”，素材来自对 OpenAI 内部人士的深度访谈，计划数周后在 Every 发布。在正式文章完成前，他会持续分享写作过程中的线索和发现。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: Sam Altman says ChatGPT Work is remarkable and that the word “work” undersells it. From his phone, he asked the system to use his chat history to propose three long-weekend options for nine people, build a full-stack coordination site, make reservations after group agreement, and draft a Gmail message; he says the entire workflow simply worked. He also says he wants “a new kind of computer,” pointing toward an agent experience that executes across applications rather than merely answering prompts.
items.insightZh: Sam Altman 认为 ChatGPT Work 的能力已超出“work”这个名称。他从手机发出一个复合请求：利用历史对话为九人周末旅行提出三个方案，搭建供全员协商活动与目的地的 full-stack 网站，在达成共识后预订，并在 Gmail 中起草通知邮件；结果整条链路直接跑通。他同时表示自己想要“一种新的计算机”，暗示这类跨应用、可执行任务的 agent 体验正在改变计算设备的定义。
